en.title: Department of Agriculture: 4 references to U.S. Code sections repealed, omitted or not in the Code (7 CFR, chapter III, parts 330 to 371)
en.summary: In the CFR chapters assigned to the Department of Agriculture in 7 CFR, chapter III, parts 330 to 371, 4 references in 4 sections cite a U.S. Code section that release point 119-134 of the U.S. Code does not carry in force: 4 cite a repealed section. The release names no successor for these sections.
en.impact: A reader who follows these references does not reach the text the rule relies on. No effect on a decision or an amount has been established.
en.correction: The agency decides whether to remove or replace each reference. The U.S. Code names no successor for these sections.
